Name: The Pretty Valley Project
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[heading][size=6]🌸 Pretty Valley The Project 🌸[/size][/heading]
[size=4][i]              One mod. One soft pastel Stardew Valley.[/i] ✨[/size]

Sage-mint grass, blush-rose dirt, pink sand, lilac water, white-and-pastel buildings, flower-trimmed menus, pastel animals and Junimos in bloom. This mod only edits images. It never changes items, NPCs, maps, events or your save.

[b][u][size=5]🌿 Nature[/size][/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Grass, dirt, beach sand and the seasonal outdoor, beach, island and town tilesheets, with optional wildflowers in the grass 🌼[/*]
[*]Oak, maple, pine, palm, mushroom, mystic and fruit trees 🌳[/*]
[*]Berry, tea and decorative bushes, plus crop and flower growth stages 🍓[/*]
[*]Pastel lilac water for rivers, lakes, ponds, the ocean and Ginger Island 💜[/*]
[*]Natural brown and grey beach rocks that stand out from the pink sand 🪨[/*]
[*]Seasonal vines and flowers on town buildings, flower beds, fences and benches 🌷[/*]
[*]Softer, cozier colors inside the town buildings 🏘️[/*]
[/list][size=5]🏡 Farm[/size]
[list]
[*]White-and-pastel barns, coops, stable, sheds, silo, well, mill and slime hutch, with edge vines and flowers. Doors and windows are white 🤍[/*]
[*]Plank and Stone cabins ⛰️[/*]
[*]Whitewashed farmhouse with a pink porch, window boxes, lilac door mats and a mossy roof whose blooms change with the season (snow in winter ❄️)[/*]
[*]Greenhouse with seasonal blooms 🌺[/*]
[*]Cloud shipping bin with lid animation ☁️ and a magical mailbox 💌[/*]
[*]Pastel pink machines with rainbow symbols and cloud-latch chests 🌈[/*]
[*]Sprinklers in your choice of Toadstool 🍄, Frog 🐸, Teacup 🫖 or Vanilla[/*]
[/list][size=5]🐾 Animals and pets[/size]
[list]
[*]Every farm animal and pet breed in its own pastel color 🎀[/*]
[*]Each has a contrasting second shade on its details and markings, so turtle shells, spots and shading stand out 🐢[/*]
[*]Deep plum outlines[/*]
[*]Covers cows, pigs, sheep, goats, chickens, ducks, rabbits, ostriches, dinosaurs, all cats, all dogs, the horse and turtles 🐮🐷🐑🐐🐔🦆🐰🦖🐱🐶🐴[/*]
[/list][size=5]💚 Junimos and Joja[/size]
[list]
[*]Junimos with a little flower and leaves, light bodies and plum outlines 🌱[/*]
[*]Mossy Junimo Hut with vines and flowers in every season 🍃[/*]
[*]Luma from East Scarp NPCs ✨[/*]
[*]Joja Mart in lilac and blush, inside and out: the store, truck, crates and Joja Cola sign 💜[/*]
[/list][size=5]🚌 Bus and world[/size]
[list]
[*]Seasonal hippie bus with flowers and rainbow stripes 🌈[/*]
[*]The bus also shows correctly in Lilybrook, Stardew Valley Expanded and Ridgeside Village 🚏[/*]
[*]Pastel mine monsters 👾 and floral weapons ⚔️[/*]
[/list][size=5]💖 Interface[/size]
[list]
[*]Blush-pink menus, dialogue boxes, tooltips, toolbar, tabs and buttons[/*]
[*]HUD: clock, day panel, energy and health bars, weather icons[/*]
[*]Sunset title screen with a new logo and buttons 🌅[/*]
[*]Letters, billboard, bundle page, special orders board and forge[/*]
[*]Flower-trimmed tools, rods, pans, trash cans and scythes 🌸[/*]
[/list][size=5]⚙️ Options[/size]
Everything is on by default, and each part has its own on/off switch. Generic Mod Config Menu is supported.
[list]
[*][b]Strength:[/b] Soft, Medium or Strong palette[/*]
[*][b]Nature:[/b] RecolorTerrain, RecolorTrees, RecolorBushes, RecolorCropsAndFlowers, WildflowerGrass, PurpleWater, SeasonalFlora, SoftInteriors[/*]
[*][b]Farm:[/b] RecolorBuildings, RecolorFarmhouse, RecolorShippingBin, RecolorMailbox, RecolorMachines, SprinklerStyle[/*]
[*][b]Creatures and places:[/b] RecolorAnimals, RecolorJunimos, RecolorJoja, RecolorBus, RecolorMonsters, RecolorWeapons[/*]
[*][b]Interface:[/b] EnableMenus, EnableHud, EnableTitle, EnableBoards, EnableTools, Florals[/*]
[/list][size=5]📋 Requirements[/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0+, Content Patcher 2.5.0+[/*]
[*]Optional, detected automatically: Stardew Valley Expanded, DaisyNiko’s Tilesheets, Ridgeside Village, East Scarp Village, Lilybrook and Central Station[/*]
[/list][size=5]🤝 Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley Expanded:[/b] pastel trees and bus. Its Galdoran menus win over this UI unless you set
[code]DisableGaldoranTheme[/code]to true in SVE’s config.[/*]
[*][b]Ridgeside Village:[/b] pastel terrain, waterfalls, trees and the flower bus.[/*]
[*][b]East Scarp Village:[/b] pastel terrain, DeepDark water and a recolored Luma. Its buildings are left as drawn.[/*]
[*][b]Lilybrook and Central Station:[/b] the flower bus shows after the bus ride.[/*]
[*][b]Other mods:[/b] farm buildings, animals and Junimos win over other mods that edit the same image. Nature and the UI lose to them. Turn the matching option off to keep another mod’s look, for example
[code]RecolorFarmhouse[/code]with Leafy Cottage or
[code]RecolorJunimos[/code]with Vivian’s Junimo Huts.[/*]
[*][b]Left as vanilla:[/b] wooden-roofed cabins, obelisks, the Gold Clock, the Fish Pond, pet bowls, woodpiles, the abandoned Joja Mart and the Joja Community Center route.[/*]
[/list]🔁 Replaces these mods (delete them first)
[list]
[*][CP] Pretty Valley[/*]
[*][CP] Pretty Valley - SVE and DaisyNiko Add-on[/*]
[*]PrettyValleyBinAndMailbox[/*]
[*][CP] Seasonal Hippie Bus[/*]
[*][CP] Meadow Cottage UI[/*]
[/list]The unique ID is new (
[code]NesrynAstraRose.PrettyValleyTheProject[/code]), so update any mod that lists an old ID as a dependency.
📦 Install
[list=1]
[*]Put the
[code][CP] Pretty Valley The Project[/code]folder in
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*][b]To update:[/b] delete the old folder, then copy in the new one. Don’t merge.[/*]
[*][b]To uninstall:[/b] delete the folder.[/*]
[/list]📝 Changelog

Manifest.Name: Pretty Valley The Project
Manifest.Description: A cute pastel, cottagecore recolor of Stardew Valley: nature, town flora, UI, tools, machines, weapons, monsters, sprinklers and water, all in one pack with config options.
Manifest.Author: Nesryn Astra Rose
